title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding‑edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high‑performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution.
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments.
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms.
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community.
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel.
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel.
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners.

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded.
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers.
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals.
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git.
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded.
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging.
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other low‑level system engineering.
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives.
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1‑3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e‑commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2‑4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3‑6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Associate Solutions Architect – TestBox

Remote — Must be based in Rio de Janeiro or Niterói

$36,000 USD / year + equity & benefits

About TestBox

TestBox was founded with a bold mission : to fundamentally transform how software is bought and sold. We're building an innovative platform that empowers buyers with transparent, interactive software experiences, while equipping sellers with powerful tools to deliver exceptional buying and onboarding journeys. Our core technologies—synthetic data, intelligent orchestration, and our unique product graph—help teams achieve faster implementations, clearer insights, and increase trust with their customers.

At TestBox, we're not just improving demos; we're building the next generation infrastructure for software transactions, creating seamless experiences from initial interest to successful onboarding and beyond.

We're a fast-growing startup built by a team that values experimentation, velocity, and customer impact. We're backed by world-class investors and are building a platform that's disrupting the traditional B2B sales motion.

Role Overview

As a Solutions Architect at TestBox, you'll be at the heart of our customer experience—designing, building, and delivering high-impact demo and POC environments that drive sales success for our customers.

You’ll lead technical delivery, participate in agile rituals like standups and retros, and act as a trusted consultant to help customers design stories that resonate. You’ll also be expected to innovate and move fast—this isn't a role for someone looking to just “follow the playbook.”

To succeed here, you’ll need to be curious, flexible, and scrappy. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams, and you’ll use AI tools (including our own) daily to boost your productivity, generate data, and solve complex problems creatively.

Key Responsibilities Project Ownership & Delivery
  • Lead end-to-end implementation of customer demo and POC environments—from kickoff through delivery.
  • Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and retros; communicate blockers and drive timelines forward.
  • Collaborate across customer engineering, solutions, and product teams to ensure smooth handoffs and clear technical execution.
Customer Storytelling & Consulting
  • Help customers craft compelling demo narratives grounded in real-world buyer personas, workflows, and industry context.
  • Design fictional yet realistic companies and user journeys to simulate how the product solves specific problems.
  • Advise on best practices for demo structure, content pacing, and emotional resonance.
Environment Implementation
  • Configure CRM, support, or comms tools with customized fields, workflows, and industry templates.
  • Simulate real user behavior using automation, time-based triggers, and behavioral scripting. (We integrate AI-powered interactions where relevant to enhance realism)
AI-Driven Efficiency
  • Leverage AI tools (including LLMs like OpenAI and Anthropic, automation platforms) to speed up data generation, ticket writing, and documentation.
  • Continuously explore ways to innovate and disrupt traditional workflows using AI—TestBox is built on this mindset.
Documentation & Ticket Writing
  • Create detailed technical tickets and documentation to support repeatable environment setup and engineering handoffs.
  • Maintain internal knowledge resources for templates, industry scenarios, and technical edge cases.
Who You Are
  • You're fluent in english.
  • You're resourceful, autonomous, and outcomes-driven —comfortable leading projects with limited structure.
  • You think like a builder, act like an owner, and communicate like a product manager.
  • You thrive in startups : ambiguity excites you, pivots don't scare you, and you prioritize speed over perfection.
  • You believe AI is a power tool , not a novelty—and you're already using it to make your work better and faster.
  • You're comfortable translating between customer needs and technical systems, and enjoy being at the intersection of product, engineering, and sales.
Preferred Qualifications
  • 3–5 years in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, Implementation, or similar technical consulting roles.
  • Ability to write and manage technical tickets and documentation for delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, and data formats like CSV and JSON.
  • Experience working in agile environments (standups, retros, ticket grooming, etc.).
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, text‑to‑speech engines, automation platforms) to drive efficiency, draft technical documentation, create demo content, or solve complex problems.
  • Bonus : Familiarity with synthetic data or interactive storytelling in demos. Completion of AI‑focused courses, certifications, or hands‑on projects.
Why Join TestBox
  • Shape the future of how software is bought and sold.
  • Build with a team that values autonomy, curiosity, and experimentation.
  • Use AI every day—not as a gimmick, but as a core productivity engine.
  • Make a direct impact in a high-growth startup redefining the demo experience.

title: Danielle Bibas é nomeada CEO da Pierre Fabre
description:
Com longo histórico na Avon e passagem de um ano pelo Grupo Petrópolis executiva substitui Ana Paula Magri. Danielle Bibas acaba de assumir o cargo de chief executive officer (CEO) da filial brasileira da companhia francesa Pierre Fabre, sediada no Rio de Janeiro.

Ela substitui Ana Paula Magri, que havia sido a primeira pessoa brasileira a ocupar o comando da empresa no País.

Com isso, Danielle estará à frente do negócio que, no Brasil, comercializa as marcas Eau Thermal Avène (marca francesa especializada em dermocosméticos e uma das líderes em venda na Europa), Ducray (também francesa e focada em alta ciência e medicalização) e Darrow Laboratório (marca brasileira de dermocosméticos para pele oleosa e que, segundo a empresa faz sucesso entre a GenZ e começou a ser exportada para outros países da América Latina recentemente).

Danielle trabalhou como CMO do Grupo Petrópolis de setembro de 2022 a setembro de 2023, mas antes disso teve um longo histórico na Avon.

Na companhia de beleza, onde trabalhou por 12 anos, ocupou os cargos de CMO no Brasil e vice-presidente de marketing global. Imediatamente antes da Avon, também teve um histórico de 16 anos na P&G, onde também lidou com a categoria de saúde e beleza, tendo seu último cargo por lá sido o de presidente de Health and Beauty Care, no Canadá.

Metas estabelecidas

Há dois anos, a filial brasileira da Pierre Fabre – cujo faturamento global gira em torno de € 2,8 bilhões – ocupava a 10ª posição no mapa da companhia. E a então CEO, Ana Paula, afirmava que o objetivo era que o Brasil subisse cinco posições nesse ranking, dobrando o tamanho dos negócios até 2026.

Na cidade de Areal, no Rio de Janeiro, está instalada a única fábrica da Pierre Fabre fora da França. E desde 2018 o País também abriga o Brazilian Innovation Center (BIC), focado no desenvolvimento de produtos para a população local.

description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York, and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform food production in the tropics.
Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils, creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We collaborate with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are experiencing rapid growth.
Our culture emphasizes people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket symbolizes our ambition; the Heart reflects our empathy, integrity, and collective impact.
We pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive team, primarily based in Brazil, where the climate impact is most significant. You can read reviews on Glassdoor about our interview process.

Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo or surrounding regions preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English (fluent)
Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We seek a seasoned, strategic, and hands-on COO to lead our go-to-market strategy for mineral-based carbon removal products across agriculture and mining sectors . You will oversee our entire value chain, from mineral inputs and field operations to our science engine and technology roadmap. This senior role combines bold strategy with operational precision to scale our impact.
Your role involves refining product-market fit , identifying scalable customer use cases , and leading the integration of deployment, scientific standards, and operational scaling. You will collaborate closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations on regional management and logistics, and with our VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and climate goals. You will ensure our product offers agronomic value and meets carbon certification standards, scaling pilots into high-impact operations at a national level.
The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , preferably in Brazilian agribusiness , capable of bridging execution with innovation .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Help us shape the future of open source IT, devops, and IS, from bare metal to containers. Our goal is to revolutionise open source application and infrastructure operations.

We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.

The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.

Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.

This role is ideal for software engineers who want to work in a global team, have a passion for distributed systems and cloud computing, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers.

What you will do

  • Work in Python and Golang to design and deliver open source software operations code
  • Work with the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications
  • Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure
  • Rethink open source operations for our customers and open source community
  • Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code
  • Follow agile software development practices
  • Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Global travel up to 10% of time for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You are a passionate Python developer
  • You are organised and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software
  • You understand the importance of reliable operations in an agile world
  • You have sound knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies
  • You have practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • You are a lifelong learner

Bonus points for

  • You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field
  • Golang programming skills

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Nossa Cultura

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica

O Técnico de Engenharia Clínica é o profissional técnico responsável por assegurar o funcionamento contínuo, seguro e eficaz do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele executa manutenções preventivas, corretivas, calibrações e ensaios, garantindo a disponibilidade dos equipamentos para o atendimento ao paciente, em conformidade com as normas técnicas e os procedimentos internos. Sua atuação é fundamental para a segurança do paciente e a eficiência operacional da instituição de saúde.

  • Execução de Manutenções e Intervenções Técnicas: Realizar manutenções corretivas nos equipamentos médico-hospitalares, desde a abertura do chamado até a identificação da falha e a intervenção técnica, visando restaurar todas as funcionalidades e retomar a operação de forma segura. Executar manutenções planejadas/programadas (preventivas e preditivas), utilizando padrões e simuladores adequados, para garantir que os equipamentos estejam sempre aptos para uso seguro, com laudos e certificados válidos. Realizar calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica nos equipamentos, seguindo os procedimentos e normas técnicas aplicáveis, para assegurar a precisão e a segurança dos dispositivos.
  • Gestão de Equipamentos e Controle Patrimonial: Realizar o controle e rastreio de equipamentos por meio de rondas diárias, verificando o estado geral, a localização e a condição de uso, para garantir sua conservação e disponibilidade. Acompanhar o recebimento de novos equipamentos e insumos, conferindo notas fiscais e a contagem dos produtos, e testando os equipamentos para verificar sua aptidão para o uso. Preservar e zelar pelos equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, mantendo-os organizados, limpos e conservados, e solicitando novas ferramentas ao supervisor quando necessário, demonstrando cuidado com o patrimônio da empresa.
  • Documentação e Registro no Sistema: Alimentar o sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), realizando a abertura de Ordens de Serviço (OS) e preenchendo detalhadamente as ações executadas, peças utilizadas e observações, para garantir um histórico preciso e completo do equipamento. Assegurar a correta emissão de laudos e certificados de acordo com as normativas vigentes, após a execução das manutenções e calibrações.
  • Acompanhamento e Suporte: Manter o supervisor imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e os desafios encontrados, buscando soluções e alinhando as atividades diariamente. Acompanhar as atividades de serviços realizados por terceiros dentro da unidade, por meio da análise de ordens de serviço externas, para garantir o registro e histórico completo dos equipamentos. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo que venham a ser delegadas pelo supervisor de engenharia clínica.
  • Relacionamento e Otimização: Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações conforme a necessidade do cliente, através do contato com fornecedores, com o objetivo de apoiar a ampliação dos serviços e soluções oferecidas.

Data Scientist

One year in Norway, a career in Brazil—grow with us across borders

calendar_today

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. description:
Conheça sua missão:

  • Em situações de furo de estoque, acompanha atentamente a gestão do setor, envolvendo a consideração de oferecer produtos similares ou a confirmação da ruptura, visando assegurar que a expedição seja realizada na data de entrega acordada;
  • Garante o fluxo da demanda de retirada imediata do dia, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a produtividade e a qualidade. Também monitora os pedidos com prazos de retirada expirados, tomando as ações necessárias, como o contato com o cliente ou o cancelamento do pedido;
  • Mantém uma interação diária com a torre de controle e também reuniões mensais, avaliando as ocorrências e prestando suporte à equipe de administração logística, com acompanhamento atento do gestor;
  • Exerce supervisão sobre a equipe ADM, garantindo que todas as entregas programadas para o dia tenham Documento de Transporte (DT). Em casos de falta desse documento, atua diretamente junto à transportadora para garantir que o processo de roteirização seja concluído, assegurando que nosso indicador OTIF (On-Time In-Full) não seja prejudicado;
  • Utiliza o painel de roteirização para extrair informações relevantes que embasam suas decisões, antecipando-se a possíveis problemas apontados em ressalvas feitas pelos clientes e agilizando as soluções;
  • Busca constantemente maior agilidade e eficiência na resolução de casos de furo de estoque, aplicando análises cuidadosas e tomando decisões assertivas com relativa autonomia;
  • Identifica os gargalos operacionais e organiza a equipe de acordo com os picos de maior fluxo, assegurando que o tempo de separação dos pedidos e a permanência do cliente no local estejam alinhados com as diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa;
  • Demonstra habilidade na análise de relatórios, propondo ações destinadas a aprimorar os processos existentes e alcançar os resultados almejados;
  • Contribui com o Gerente de Operações Logísticas, selecionando, contratando, animando, desenvolvendo e retendo conforme avaliação e necessidades do setor;
  • Atua na busca contínua por oportunidades de melhoria, antecipa-se a problemas, contribuindo com soluções adequadas;
  • Colabora com seu gestor na elaboração de relatórios voltados para o aumento da produtividade e o alcance dos objetivos do setor;
  • Torna-se uma referência para a equipe, compartilhando os números do setor e atingindo as metas estabelecidas;
  • Orienta os colaboradores da equipe para o plano diário de gestão, e supervisiona a realização das atividades. Acompanha o controle de estoque, incluindo endereçamentos, armazenamento de posições e realizações de inventários;
  • Assegura o bom uso e manutenção das ferramentas que estão à disposição da suas equipes (Cintas, Etiquetadoras, Coletores de dados, Empilhadeiras, Paleteiras, Rádios, Impressoras, Computadores, etc);
  • Garantir a eficácia de todos os processos relacionados à gestão de inventário, tanto rotativo quanto geral. Monitora a execução dos processos de movimentações, transitórios, endereçamento e negativos e promove a disseminação da cultura de endereçamento correto;
  • Assegura o cumprimento do procedimento de furo de estoque e mantem a vigilância constante sobre o monitoramento de deficiências de estoque no sistema e prepara relatórios semanais sobre o tema. Auxilia no processo de treinamento e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores (loja e logística) para uso dos recursos e aderência aos processos de movimentação e armazenagem de material;
  • Representa papel central na luta anti demarca e apresenta relatórios de maior profundidade durante as reuniões de briefing e, é um modelo de eficácia no contra poder e na adoção de boas práticas;
  • Orientar os colaboradores da equipe para o plano diário de operação, colaborar para a prevenção de perdas, zelar pela qualidade e conservação do estoque de mercadorias, zelar pelo o pátio logístico, direcionando sua equipe para mantê-lo sempre limpo e organizado;
  • Garante que todas as mercadorias sejam conferidas e estejam em perfeitas condições. monitorar a coleta das devoluções conforme acordos comerciais estabelecidos, orientando a equipe para melhor comunicação e seguimento dos processos;
  • Instrui a equipe a comunicar ao suporte de cadastros qualquer discrepância nos produtos cadastrados, como forma de prevenir erros no estoque. Desenvolve escala de trabalho, sempre verificando a necessidade operacional e normas legislativas;
  • Conduz a sua equipe na delimitação adequada dos espaços conforme o produto a ser recebido para otimizar o gerenciamento da conferência e da armazenagem, orienta os terceiros, responsáveis pela paletização, assegurando que esse processo seja realizado corretamente, seguindo os padrões definidos;
  • Garante o registro completo dos fretes FOB e certifica se todos foram pagos corretamente, efetuando o controle do pallets em débito com os fornecedores, garantindo a transparência nas relações comerciais e o cumprimento das obrigações;
  • Cria agendas de treinamentos para os demais setores, sobre o processo de devoluções via acordo comercial, visando instruí-los sobre o procedimento padrão de paletização e conferência, garantindo que todos sigam os protocolos estabelecidos.

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
Join to apply for the Chief Executive Officer role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

Prioritizing Well‑being and Professional Growth

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Purpose of Job

The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Howard University (HU) Faculty Practice Plan (FPP) has responsibility for the achievement of the strategic, operational, and financial goals of HU FPP. This position is responsible for the day‑to‑day operations and execution of the strategic vision for the HU FPP, including overseeing and directing organizational and physician alignment, operating and financial efficiency of clinical enterprises, practice management, revenue cycle services, expansion of referral sources, information technology and electronic health record management implementation, managed care contracting, and marketing and public relations.

This position is responsible for ensuring that high quality, innovative, and financially sustainable operations are in place and effectively managed to support HU FPP. The CEO of HU FPP will help to ensure that HU FPP is well‑positioned in a rapidly evolving and competitive environment through optimized and systematic physician practice management. Additionally, in conjunction with the management team, this position will lead efforts to collaborate with community healthcare providers to enhance patient access in the communities served by HU FPP.

Job Responsibilities
  • Profit and Loss (P&L) responsibility for the operations of HU FPP, including all aspects of effective operational and financial management and reporting, managed care contracting, and operational and capital budgeting.
  • Implement operational processes and drive efficiencies at HU FPP to reduce administrative burden for HU FPP physicians.
  • Develop and implement key initiatives to improve deficiencies ascertained through the evaluation of operations.
  • Collaborate with Physician Enterprise leadership to apply effective processes, practice management tools, and best practices to the management of HU FPP.
  • Evaluate the organizational structure for HU FPP, identifying the core competencies for each organizational unit, and effectively designing the relationships between organizational units to drive effective governance.
  • Identify organizational goals, establish baseline metrics, develop key performance indicators, and standardize processes and monitor performance against goals, including those related to patient satisfaction, physician engagement and satisfaction, employee engagement, patient access, clinical excellence and patient safety, efficiency and effectiveness, and financial performance.
  • Create and maintain a culture of accountability and serve as a resource for attaining performance metrics in all areas of the HU FPP.
  • Implement Adventist HealthCare standard management approach across all departments at HU FPP.
  • Work with Adventist HealthCare and HU for the development of the strategic vision for HU FPP and execution of strategic initiatives.
  • Effectively communicate the mission, vision, values, and strategic vision of HU FPP to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Closely collaborate with the Chief Medical Officer to drive achieving mutual goals and cultivating long‑term, collaborative relationships with HU FPP physicians.
  • Evaluate strategic partnership opportunities with community‑based organizations, payors, and other community stakeholders.
  • Identify new opportunities in population health and with alternative payment models.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Chairs, Leadership and departmental Administrators, Physicians and Staff from diverse background and perspectives, across clinical and academic missions of an academic medical center to ensure efficient, effective clinic operations, while creating an environment conducive to engagement and satisfaction among physicians, other practitioners, and clinical staff.
Required Qualifications Competencies Knowledge
  • Knowledge of advanced primary care practice principles and Patient‑Centered Medical Home (PCMH) principles
  • Knowledge of principles and practices of health care practice operations and management sufficient to manage, direct, and coordinate the operations of a health care organization’s physician practices
  • Knowledge of the purposes, organization, and policies of the community's health systems sufficient to interact with other health care providers
  • Knowledge of the physician recruitment and development strategies
  • Knowledge of sophisticated practice management operations and qualified and conversant in Medicare Access and Medicaid Reauthorization Act (MACRA) and Merit‑based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) strategies and value‑based reimbursement such as PCMH programs
  • Knowledge and experience at a large academic health program that included practice plan administration services
Skills
  • Skill in exercising a high degree of initiative, judgment, discretion, and decision‑making to achieve organizational objectives.
  • Skill in analyzing situations accurately and taking effective action.
  • Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with employees, policy‑making bodies, third‑party payers, patients, and the public.
  • Skill in organizing work, making assignments, and achieving goals and objectives.
  • Skill in exercising judgment and discretion in developing, applying, interpreting, and coordinating departmental policies and procedures.
Abilities
  • Ability to assume responsibility.
  • Ability to establish and maintain quality control standards.
  • Ability to organize and integrate organizational priorities and deadlines.
  • Ability to communicate, including the ability to negotiate and resolve conflicts and build teams.
  • Skill in articulating and presenting data, information and ideas in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to communicate with physicians, academic department leaders and senior administrators to maintain coordination with other organizational programs.
Education and Experience Education
  • M.B.A. or similar management degree required
Experience
  • Minimum 10 years executive‑level experience including 7 years of experience in the administration of a health care organization
  • Experience in a large academic health system, including experience with practice plan administration
Supervisory/Management Experience
  • Experience in a large academic health system, including experience with practice plan administration

A L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, a L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a "criar a beleza que move o mundo"; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões.untos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.

Missão

Em colaboração com a Equipe de TI, Divisões de Negócios e Áreas Corporativas, o Corporate BRM (Business Relationship Manager) e Client Services Lead é o principal Parceiro de Negócios para as Áreas Corporativas e também responsável pela operação transversal de serviços ao cliente no Brasil. Ele/Ela será responsável por manter o engajamento e a comunicação com os stakeholders, compreender o negócio, auxiliar na priorização de projetos, garantindo que os projetos estejam alinhados com uma tecnologia que proporcione o máximo retorno sobre o investimento.

Client Services Lead

Eles supervisionam o desempenho e o alinhamento dos serviços de TI, garantem a conformidade com os padrões e SLAs, gerenciam os relacionamentos com os stakeholders e promovem uma cultura de melhoria contínua de serviços usando dados e análises.

  • Fazer parceria com a Equipe de Infraestrutura para garantir o melhor em Gerenciamento de Rede, Gerenciamento de Servidores, Operações de Armazenamento e Data Center, Gerenciamento de Hardware e Software, Monitoramento de Sistemas e Otimização de Desempenho, Gerenciamento de Configuração, Segurança e Continuidade de Negócios, Planejamento de Recuperação de Desastres.
Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Experiência em Metodologia de Projetos (PMI, PMO).

title: Página da Vaga | Superintendente de Produção
description:
Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Estamos buscando um Superintendente de Produção para compor nosso time de operações Offshore. Com a missão de garantir a gestão segura e eficiente das operações de produção por meio da supervisão estratégica dos processos, controle de qualidade do óleo e descarte de água, assegurando conformidade com os parâmetros operacionais e contribuindo para a otimização da produção e redução dos custos.

Responsabilidades
  • Liderar estrategicamente as operações de produção offshore, integrando múltiplas disciplinas e unidades operacionais por meio da definição de metas, diretrizes e prioridades alinhadas aos objetivos corporativos, assegurando a entrega sustentável de resultados com foco em segurança, eficiência e conformidade regulatória.
  • Tomar decisões críticas em cenários complexos e incertos, utilizando ferramentas de gestão avançadas, indicadores de performance e análises de risco, com o objetivo de garantir a continuidade operacional, a integridade das instalações e a otimização dos recursos produtivos.
  • Influenciar a cultura organizacional e o comportamento das lideranças técnicas embarcadas, promovendo a disseminação de práticas de excelência em QSMS, gestão de riscos e prevenção de perdas, com foco na sustentabilidade dos resultados e na valorização das pessoas.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e comportamental em auditorias, investigações de incidentes e processos de melhoria contínua, assegurando que as ações corretivas e preventivas estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas da indústria de óleo e gás e aos padrões internacionais de operação segura.
  • Desenvolver e fortalecer a capacidade de liderança das equipes sob sua responsabilidade, promovendo a formação de sucessores, a gestão do conhecimento e a evolução da maturidade operacional, com foco na perenidade dos resultados e na inovação dos processos produtivos.
Formação acadêmica
  • Graduação completa em Engenharia (preferencialmente Engenharia de Produção, Petróleo, Mecânica ou Química). Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Operações, Projetos ou Negócios será considerado um diferencial.
Qualificações/certificações necessárias (Offshore)
  • A obrigatoriedade dos treinamentos técnicos está condicionada à Matriz de Treinamentos vigente.
Processo seletivo na PRIO

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, onde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO
  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas também entenda as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas; prezamos pela transparência, por isso não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS) role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu.

Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Ubuntu is easy to deploy and configure, one node at a time, but it's difficult to know where you stand on policy and compliance, patch management, or access control across a large estate. Ubuntu used to be under the radar in the enterprise, but it is now becoming an official platform for many companies. Those enterprises very much want a high quality way to manage their Ubuntu estate.

We started work on Landscape many years ago, and the current generation of the service reflects the choices of the day. We now have the opportunity to invest significantly in a team to bring a fresh new vision for large-scale Ubuntu estate management to the project. That doesn't make this a greenfield opportunity - we have a system that serves thousands of deployments - but we know we want to step back and give it a big new push, letting go of some things that are no longer so important, and embracing a range of new priorities. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.

Today we use Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, HAProxy, and have a ReactJS front end. In other web services projects we use more Golang these days. Our next wave of Landscape engineering is an opportunity to raise the bar on SAAS and on-prem solution technologies, architectures, patterns and operations. Our goal is to make it easy for enterprises to own a few Landscape instances that serve their global estate, and to be able to apply policy and know intuitively where they stand - globally - in a very complex world of mixed Ubuntu versions, substrates and flavours.

Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of their teams. You will work closely with product managers, and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. A successful applicant will be capable of growing a team of engineers, collaborating with other engineering and business teams at Canonical, and providing periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your region
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel 4-6 weeks per year for internal and external events

Valued Skills And Experience

  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Lead an engineering team that partners with Linux engineers of a major silicon company, working across the full Linux stack—from kernel to GUI—to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

This role is fast-paced and problem-solving oriented, requiring resourcefulness, articulation, and the ability to deliver solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams collaborate with engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

As a Partner Engineering Manager at Canonical, your role involves managing relationships with key technology partners by ensuring timely delivery on project milestones. Technical leadership and a background in software engineering are essential. You will lead, challenge, and develop engineers, influence culture positively, facilitate technical delivery, and contribute to strategy and execution.

What you'll do

  • Lead a distributed team to design and implement Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server hardware platforms and software stacks.

  • Develop your team through coaching, mentoring, leading by example, and feedback.
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery of project milestones.
  • Maintain high standards of quality and reliability.
  • Coordinate with other teams at Canonical for alignment on product architecture and roadmaps.
  • Work from home with global travel up to twice a year for up to two weeks.

Who you are

  • Experienced with Linux distributions, Debian packaging, and high-performance server hardware.
  • Skilled in working directly with customers, resolving technical issues, and understanding business challenges.
  • Proven experience managing or leading software engineering teams.
  • Familiar with agile development methodologies.
  • Effective at collaborating across teams, building trust, and delivering results.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and oral.

title: Project management office - pmo pleno/sênior
description:

Atuará garantindo a aplicação de metodologias de gestão de projetos, controle de prazos, custos, escopo, riscos e qualidade, assegurando a entrega dos resultados conforme as metas estratégicas da organização.

Definir, padronizar e disseminar metodologias, templates e processos de gestão de projetos.
Apoiar equipes de projeto na elaboração de cronogramas, planos de implantação e matrizes de risco.

Graduação completa em Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos de implantação de sistemas corporativos 
Conhecimento em metodologias de gestão de projetos ágeis.
Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (MS Project).
Habilidade com análise de indicadores (KPIs) e elaboração de relatórios executivos.

Conhecimento em testes automatizados;

title: Ajudante de padeiro i - (cópia)
description:
O cargo de ajudante de padeiro na produção de pães congelados exige perfil proativo, atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de trabalho em equipe. As responsabilidades vão além do simples apoio ao padeiro, abrangendo diversas etapas do processo produtivo em ambiente fabril. As atividades incluem o apoio no preparo de massas, organização de ingredientes, limpeza de utensílios, e outras funções essenciais para o bom andamento da produção. Devido ao contato direto com alimentos, é essencial que o ajudante de padeiro tenha rigorosos cuidados com a higiene pessoal e siga as normas sanitárias vigentes, incluindo o uso adequado de uniformes, EPIs e por determinação das boas práticas de fabricação (BPF) e em conformidade com as orientações da ANVISA (RDC nº 275/2002) é proibido o uso de barba, visando evitar riscos de contaminação dos alimentos.

Transporte de Matéria-prima

Manejo de Gelo

Manipulação de Massa

Operação de Cilindro

Operação de Empacotadora

Limpeza e higienização das maquinas e bancadas utilizadas

title: Vendedor(a)
description:
Sobre a Naturativa

Muito prazer, somos a Naturativa!
Uma farmácia de manipulação com 30 anos de história. São mais de 6 milhões de receitas manipuladas com qualidade certificada.

Um dos nossos maiores orgulhos e diferenciais é ser a única farmácia de manipulação do Rio de Janeiro a ter o selo ISO 9001 ABNT - INMETRO - uma certificação internacional de qualidade - e isso há mais de 20 anos consecutivos! Para isso, passamos todos os anos por auditorias e investimos em processos que garantem a qualidade dos nossos produtos.
A gente acredita que cada receita, assim como cada cliente são únicos e, por isso, investimos todos os dias para fazer o melhor. Mais do que fabricar medicamentos, nossa missão é trazer saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida.
Imagina fazer parte dessa história e saber o que há por trás de tudo isso e do que a Naturativa é feita?! Vem com a gente!

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES:

- Receber e organizar os pagamentos recebidos em loja
- Consolidar e enviar o movimento do caixa do dia anterior para o setor Financeiro
- Operar o equipamento de caixa, acompanhando as condições de abertura e fechamento da operação, repassando numerários e conferindo valores repassados e Davs com respectivos pagamentos.

- Receber o pagamento dos clientes

- Executar as baixas das vendas do dia

- Tirar inconsistências no sistema

­- Conferir cheques e buscar informações

title: Coordenador de prospecção de leads
description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia que está há mais de 20 anos no mercado, que não apenas é parceira premier do Google Cloud, mas também já foi 5 vezes premiada como Partner of the year? Uma empresa que além de ser fera naquilo que faz, também valoriza e leva a  sério o compromisso com cada IPNETER, possuindo há 6 anos consecutivos o selo Great Place To Work.
Pois é, essa empresa existe. Essa empresa é a IPNET by Vivo!  

Além disso, somos comprometidos com a inclusão, abraçando cada forma única de ser humano, independente de etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, habilidades físicas ou mentais. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas. Aqui, não apenas reconhecemos, mas também celebramos as diferentes identidades, experiências e talentos de cada pessoa que faz parte do nosso time.

E, estamos com uma vaga aberta para Coordenador de Prospecção de Leads, que irá atuar dentro do nosso time de Growth Team, sendo responsável por:

  • Liderar, desenvolver e engajar o time de SDRs, garantindo alta performance e desenvolvimento individual;

  • Atuar diretamente na definição e acompanhamento de metas, indicadores e métricas de qualificação de leads;

  • Monitorar KPIs e métricas de conversão, propondo melhorias contínuas;

  • Realizar feedbacks individuais e coletivos, desenvolvendo as habilidades do time;

  • Ser referência em boas práticas de prospecção, cold call, cadências e uso de ferramentas de automação;

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os time de  marketing e vendas para alinhamento do funil e otimização da jornada do cliente.

Entendemos que para atender as demandas da vaga, é necessário que o candidato possua:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência prévia  em posição de liderança, como coordenador em times de SDR/Inside Sales;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de vendas (SPIN Selling, BANT ou similares);
  • Capacidade de análise de métricas e resultados;
  • Experiência no uso de CRM (Salesforce);
  • Vivência em empresas de SaaS, Cloud ou soluções tecnológicas.

Na IPNET by Vivo, acreditamos no trabalho híbrido como forma de fortalecer nossa cultura e acelerar nosso engajamento, respeitando, ao mesmo tempo, a flexibilidade. Por essa razão, nossa proposta consiste em trabalhar 2X na semana home-office e 3X presencialmente no escritório. Atualmente, contamos com dois escritórios no Brasil: um no Rio de Janeiro (Zona Portuária/Santo Cristo) e outro em São Paulo (Cidade Monções/Sede Eco Berrini).

Reconhecemos a importância dos benefícios, e por isso, nosso pacote contempla:

Auxílio Refeição/Alimentação 

Auxílio Transporte 

Plano de Saúde 

Plano Odontológico

Auxílio Home-Office 

Wellhub

Seguro de Vida

Auxílio Creche/Babá
Happy Day no mês do seu aniversário 

Parcerias com instituições educacionais, tanto de idiomas quanto acadêmicas

 

Se você se identificou com os requisitos descritos acima, não pense 2 vezes. Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que abraça a inovação e onde o caos não assusta, porque somos um time que joga junto, possui um papo reto e uma cabeça de dono!

Como Jovem Aprendiz aqui, você terá registro em Carteira de Trabalho Profissional e diversos benefícios, participará de treinamentos teóricos que vão aprimorar seu conhecimento profissional. O treinamento é dividido em : Inicial (12 dias úteis) e Intermediário (Após o período inicial, o Aprendiz precisa cumprir atividade prática (04 vezes por semana) e atividade teórica (01 vez por semana). O Espro, há mais de 40 anos desenvolve um papel estratégico na formação de adolescentes e jovens e estamos neste processo de triagem, encaminhando você e torcendo para que seja um sucesso! Não perca, esperamos você!

title: Analista fiscal junior
description:
Descrição

O Grupo Rangel Contabilidade é uma empresa altamente diferenciada que atende seus clientes internos e externos de forma individualizada, pois entendemos que seres humanos estão em constante evolução e nossa premissa é ajudar a todos a crescerem conosco, desenvolvendo suas softs skills e hard skills.

Com mais de 25 anos nessa jornada empreendedora, oferecemos serviços para empresas enquadradas no Simples Nacional, Lucro Presumido e Lucro Real, no qual, somos especialistas.

Qualificações e Habilidades Necessárias:

  • Ensino superior em ciências contábeis;
  • CRC ativo;
  • Possuir experiência na área;
  • Experiência com lucro real, presumido e simples nacional
  • Pacote office Iintermediário;

Responsabilidade da função:

  • Análisar toda a escrituração Fiscal, com lançamentos de acordo com cada atividade do cliente;
  • Apurar o ISS, ICMS Próprio, ICMS ST, Icms Diferencial de Alíquotas, Icms FOT, IPI, Pis e Cofins;
  • Análisar e apurar os impostos retidos na fonte (ISS / IRRF / CSRF);
  • Elaborar e entregar as obrigações acessórias (EFD Icms, DUB-Icms, Declan, EFD Contribuições, EFD REINF e DCTF);
  • Encerrar e controlar mensalmente o municipal;
  • Atender e dar suporte ao cliente;
  • Analisar de forma macro da tributação empregada por nossos clientes e posterior;
  • Informar ao cliente sobre erros e riscos decorrentes destes erros, assim como suas resoluções e documentação via e-mail sobre os apontamentos;
  • Atender a fiscalizações nos 03 âmbitos;
  • Utilizar os controles internos padronizados;
  • Utilizar e-mails e procedimentos padronizados, assim também, como a certificação que os mesmos são seguidos pelo seu estagiário/auxiliar;
  • Acompanhar a legislação tributária;
  • Acompanhar as tarefas executadas por seu estagiário/auxiliar.

Oferecemos uma Lista Completa de Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência dontológica;
  • Vale transporte ou combustível;
  • VR Flex;
  • Convenio com a faculdade Estácio, aonde o colaborador possui bolsas de até 70% até o final do curso;
  • Focamos no apoio a saúde física, através de nossos benefícios com descontos em academias;
  • Total pass;
  • Convênio com ótica.

Informações Indispensáveis:

  • Horário: De 08:00 às 17:00hs - de segunda a sexta-feira.
  • Regime de Contratação: CLT

title: Atendente - botafogo/rj (2)
description:
Resumo do trabalho
Fornecer um serviço amigável e criar uma experiência excepcional para todos os nossos clientes. O principal objetivo de cada atendente é proporcionar aos nossos clientes um momento tão maravilhoso para que eles sempre voltem à nossa sorveteria.
Descrição das atividades
Promover, trabalhar e agir de maneira consistente com a missão da sorveteria;
Monitorar e dar suporte para criar uma experiência memorável aos clientes. Garantir que eles estejam satisfeitos com o serviço;
Responder prontamente, com cortesia e corrigir qualquer problema que o cliente possa ter;
Organizar e limpar o salão, e deixar tudo pronto para o início dos trabalhos;
Conhecer profundamente o cardápio e todos os itens que podem ser adicionados à parte;
Fazer recomendações que você genuinamente sente que seus clientes irão desfrutar;
Auxiliar na limpeza do salão durante o expediente;
Verificar os estoques de guardanapo e papel toalha bem como organizar e higienizar esses itens para o uso dos clientes;
Verificar o estoque de todos os insumos e produtos utilizados durante o expediente de trabalho:

Verificar os pedidos dos clientes e preparar conforme descrito no recibo;

Conhecer e explicar aos clientes os sabores dos sorvetes bem como informar os ingredientes utilizados na preparação;
Fazer casquinhas e disquinhos conforme o planejamento de produção diário caso haja necessidade;
Armazenar as casquinhas e disquinhos corretamente caso haja necessidade;
Retirar o lixo no final do expediente;
Agradecer os clientes por sua visita e convidá-los a retornar;
Participar de todas as reuniões agendadas de funcionários e dar sugestões de melhoria;
Auxiliar os colegas de trabalho para atender às necessidades dos clientes e apoiar o bom funcionamento da sorveteria;
Substituir colegas de trabalho quando necessário, para garantir padrões de atendimento ao cliente e operações eficientes;
Receber e cuidar do seu uniforme por todo o tempo que permanecer na empresa;
Trabalhar devidamente uniformizado todos os dias;
Cumprir rigorosamente a jornada de trabalho, sendo pontual;

description:

Registro de informações administrativas através dos seguintes documentos eletrônicos: Relatórios Técnicos; Relatórios de Avaliação de Desempenho (Individual); Relatórios de Ocorrências; Avaliação de Competências por aprendiz; Pesquisa constante para a atualização dos conteúdos programáticos e das DGs realizadas no Programa, mantendo-o afinado com as discussões do mercado; Ambiente Virtual: Atualização de frequência, preenchimento de cadastro, avaliação de competências, monitoramento das turmas; Organização e controle das pastas físicas das turmas; Relacionamento por meio de contato telefônico e por e-mail com as empresas dos jovens; Atendimento dos jovens e empresas (pessoal e telefônico); Monitoramento das faltas e atrasos dos Aprendizes, reportando por e-mail à empresa do jovem e, em alguns casos, ao Assistente Social, para que sejam adotadas as devidas providências; Alimentar os instrumentos de controle: sala x turma, educador x turma, módulo de informática e Encontros Mensais; Distribuir os aprendizes nas turmas tantos novos quanto transferências - de acordo com as vagas disponíveis, bem como o nível da turma; Negociar com as empresas parceiras a aprovação para o encaminhamento do aprendiz para outra turma Registrar as fusões e diluições de turmas para rastreamento/acompanhamento futuro; Acompanhar a migração de aprendiz para início do módulo específico; Viabilizar o remanejamento de educador em função de falta, licença, mudança de módulo, para que a turma não seja dispensada em nenhuma hipótese..
